events.text: ROOT CAUSE FOUND: closeFFmpeg (render_surfaces.zig:478) deinits the pipe reader then calls std.process.Child.kill on the FRAME thread; Zig 0.16 childKillPosix = ONE SIGTERM + UNCANCELABLE wait4 retry loop. ffmpeg (signal()=SA_RESTART) blocked writing a 3.6MB raw frame into the undrained 64KB pipe (or restarting a V4L2 ioctl) never exits -> frame thread parks in wait4 forever. SDL's SIGTERM->SDL_QUIT needs that thread, so plain kill is ignored; only kill -9 works. Every teardown (camera switch, tab leave, quit) funnels here. Fix: detached SIGKILL+background-reap teardown, first-frame watchdog, loud ffmpeg stderr.

resolution: ROOT CAUSE: closeFFmpeg (render_surfaces.zig) deinitialized the pipe reader then called std.process.Child.kill on the FRAME thread; Zig 0.16 childKillPosix = ONE SIGTERM + an UNCANCELABLE wait4 retry loop. ffmpeg, blocked writing a raw frame into the now-undrained 64KB pipe (its signal() handlers use SA_RESTART, so the lone SIGTERM never interrupts the blocked write/V4L2 ioctl), never exits, so the frame thread parks in wait4 FOREVER. SDL turns SIGTERM into an SDL_QUIT event only that frozen thread could pump — hence plain kill ignored, kill -9 required. Every teardown (camera switch, tab leave, quit) hit it, with any camera. FIX: new framework/render/child_teardown.zig — frame thread NEVER waits on a child: synchronous SIGKILL via the platform kill utility (bounded), reap on a detached std.Io.Group task; applied to ffmpeg/qemu/app/Xvfb teardown. Plus first-frame watchdog (10s, loud, self-healing retry), pdeathsig on ffmpeg, loud stderr, and a pose-input gate so inference never reads uninitialized bytes. VERIFIED: standalone repro of the old path hangs (timeout 124) while the new path returns <2s; tripwire tests 2/2 (zig build test-child-teardown), pose-mailbox 3/3, video-devices 3/3, editor ships clean, shot /play PASS. User confirms by: open editor Globals->Animation with OBS virtual camera, switch cameras and quit — the app must stay responsive and exit on plain close; a non-streaming camera shows a loud 'camera feed FAILED: no frames from the device within 10s' line instead of freezing.
